_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Craft Acceptance Test Schedule
summary: The Craft Acceptance Test Schedule provides dates for conduct of each test procedure and associated information for test performance, informing the Government of scheduled testing to support test program monitoring.
use_relationship:
The Craft Acceptance Test Schedule provides dates for conduct of each test procedure from Stage 2 through Stage 7 and associated information for test performance. The Craft Acceptance Test Schedule informs the Government of scheduled testing which assists in monitoring the test program and in arranging for required Government-provided support.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Acceptance Test Schedule shall be based on the Craft Acceptance Test Index.

children.title: The basic parameters of the Craft Acceptance Test Schedule shall include:
Test start and test completion dates;
Ordering of prerequisite test and event items; and,

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Acceptance Test Schedule shall be presented in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Acceptance Test Schedule shall contain the following:

children.title: Title/Cover Page.
children.content: The Title/Cover Page shall provide a clear and direct statement as to the nature of the material to follow in the Craft Acceptance Test Schedule. It shall contain the following information:

children.title: A title, e.g., CRAFT ACCEPTANCE TEST SCHEDULE;
Milestone Chart.
children.content: The Milestone Chart shall contain event balloons to display each stage 2 through 7 test procedures. Normal network paths shall be displayed by a solid line. The chart shall clearly display the correct relationship of each prerequisite test or event to each dependent or subsequent test or event.

children.title: The activity duration line
children.content: The activity duration line representing a time period consumed by equipment and documentation grooming and preparation shall be provided on the chart with a realistic activity duration magnitude which shall consider and include:

children.title: Possible equipment failure and subsequent repairs:
Difficult and/or time-consuming calibration and alignments;
Equipment preparation specifically for testing (for example, test equipment hookups);
Delays due to simultaneous work activities or test activities in given craft spaces or with needed tests or other equipment; and,
The Milestones Network Chart
children.content: The Milestones Network Chart may be placed on as many sheets as necessary while still providing a reasonable and distinct interrelationship of the separate sheets of the Chart.

children.title: Test Schedule Listing.
children.content: The Test Schedule Listing shall be a tabular listing by test number which shall include the following columns:

children.title: Test Procedure number in the same order as the Craft Acceptance Test Index;
Flag for change since the last schedule issue.
Test Bar Graph Chart Schedule.
children.content: The Test Bar Chart Schedule shall be a Gantt style chart with horizontal bars showing duration of test conduct and other tests related activities. The tests and activities shall be arranged to place those of the same Ship Work Breakdown Structure (SWBS) grouping together. For each test the chart shall indicate:

children.title: Anticipated or actual changes from the scheduled dates (shown by dashed bars).
